cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25.1.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/workspace/cmake")
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-DFLAG_SUPPORTED_Wthread_safety_negative]==] [==[-Wthread-safety-negative]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/workspace/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-15FJO5")
add_executable(cmTC_ea908 "/workspace/build/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-15FJO5/src.cxx")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_ea908_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_ea908>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_ea908 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
